data.title: Should Ethereum Tax Its Apps Like a Nation? Arca’s Jeff Dorman Says It Has To
data.description: Jeff Dorman, Chief Investment Officer and co-founder of Arca, agrees with Vitalik Buterin that chasing fee burn would turn Ethereum into a stock, but argues a chain that never taxes its apps can’t give its currency much value.
